Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane of a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle was
struck on its driver side by Driver 2, who was traveling eastbound and entered the intersection as the signal turned.
Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash following the impact and was evaluated at the scene. The
Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle did not report injury. Two independent witnesses, both standing on the northwest
corner, stated that the collision occurred as described by Driver 1 and Driver 2. Scene photographs were taken and
show damage concentrated along the driver-side door and quatrer panel, which is generally in keeping with the angle
and force of a side impact of this type. Driver 2 acknowledged entering the intersection and did not dispute the
sequence of events. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle was observed
or reported. Officers were unable to fully confirm the seating position Driver 1 occupied at the moment of impact, as
the account given at the scene was not entirely precise on that point. Report prepared for the file.
